title: Wild Shape: Owlbear
html:
Wild Shape: Owlbear is a Wild Shape form available to Druids.

Description

Take the shape of an Owlbear that can  Rupture the ground and become  Enraged.

Your owlbear shape has a starting health of  65 hit points that increases every two druid levels.

Properties

Cost:
 Action +  Wild Shape Charge

At Higher Levels

The hit points and damage of the owlbear form increase with druid levels, as shown in the table below:

Druid level Hit points Bonus damage
 Claws  Crushing Flight  Rupture
6 65 +1d4 +1d4 +1d4
8 78 +1d6 +1d6 +1d6
10 94 +1d6 +1d6 +1d6
12 112 +1d8 +1d8 +1d8

 Claws ()
Lash out with deadly claws and push the target back 1.5 m / 5 ft.
 Crushing Flight ( + )
Leap at a target to bite it and knock it  Prone.
 Dismiss Wild Shape
Dismiss your Wild Shape and change back to your original form.
 Enrage ( + )
Give in to the owlbear's base instincts to increase your Strength and Constitution by 2, gain  12 temporary hit points, and possibly make nearby creatures  Fearful.
 Lunar Mend ( + )
Expend spell slots to regain Hit Points while wild shaped. You regain 1d8hit points per spell slot level.
 Rupture ()
Rupture the earth, causing debris to tear through nearby objects and creatures.

How to learn

Classes:

  • Class level 6: Druid

This action is a variation of:
Wild Shape

Notes

  • The owlbear gains 3  Rage Charges for  Enrage.
  • The owlbear loses all  Rage Charges if the player character transforms back to normal for a cutscene or conversation.
  • The owlbear uses  Crushing Flight to jump by default, including in passive pathing (i.e., when following the main character). This can cause unexpected damage to nearby NPCs, turning them hostile. Thus, it is advised to turn back into Druid form in towns to prevent accidentally provoking the entire populace.
  • Crushing Flight can be used deal large amounts of damage by crushing targets from great heights whilst  Enlarged, see Owlbear from the top ropes tactic for an in-depth explanation.
